summary: Completed comprehensive testing of BIONIC™ Territory Analysis Module. All 19 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing confirmed all requested features are working: Leaflet map, WMS layer buttons, colored probability zones, nutritional analysis modal with BIONIC™ products, and shopping cart functionality.
seed_data_creation: Test orders created with TEST_ prefix for order API testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All territory features tested and working. Backend APIs: probability (POST), cooling-zones (GET), nutrition (POST), orders (POST/GET) all return correct responses. Frontend: /territory page loads with Leaflet map, auto-login works, WMS layer buttons (Couverture forestière, Hydrographie, Relief, Routes) are present, 'Afficher zones colorées' generates 121 probability zones with legend, nutritional analysis modal shows BIONIC™ products with 'Ajouter au panier' functionality working.

backend_api.POST /api/territory/analysis/probability: PASS - Returns score 0-100, confidence level, factors, recommendations
backend_api.GET /api/territory/analysis/cooling-zone: PASS - Returns recommended zones based on species (orignal/chevreuil/ours)
backend_api.POST /api/territory/analysis/nutrition: PASS - Returns nutritional_gaps and recommended_products with BIONIC™ prioritized
backend_api.POST /api/territory/orders: PASS - Creates order with pending_approval status
backend_api.GET /api/territory/orders: PASS - Lists orders with filtering by status
backend_api.GET /api/territory/users/auto-login: PASS - Auto-creates user based on IP
backend_api.GET /api/territory/layers/wms-sources: PASS - Returns 4 Quebec government WMS layers

frontend_territory_page.auto_login: PASS - User auto-logged in as 'Chasseur XXXXXX'
frontend_territory_page.wms_layer_buttons: PASS - All 4 buttons present (Couverture forestière, Hydrographie, Relief/Courbes, Routes/Chemins)
frontend_territory_page.colored_zones: PASS - 'Afficher zones colorées' generates 121 probability zones with legend (Élevée/Moyenne/Faible)
frontend_territory_page.nutrition_modal: PASS - Opens with species analysis, carences identifiées, and BIONIC™ product recommendations
frontend_territory_page.add_to_cart: PASS - 'Ajouter au panier' button works, shows toast confirmation
frontend_territory_page.gps_navigation: PASS - Navigation GPS section with Avenza badge, waypoints, GPX import/export

frontend_shop_page.magasin_page: PASS - Shows 5 products with scores and sale modes
frontend_shop_page.product_cards: PASS - Display price, score, and cart buttons

probability_api.response_validation: Score 0-100, confidence (low/medium/high), factors dict, recommendations list

nutrition_api.response_validation: nutritional_gaps, recommended_products with BIONIC™ prioritized in top 3
